metadata.source: Z-Anatomy (CC BY-SA 4.0) landmark pointer lines, matched to the Section 11 bone cards by (C) extract_landmarks.py, 2026-11-04
metadata.units: glTF model units (about 1 mm), same frame as (C) skeleton_v2.glb before the app fits it to the screen

radius: Groove for ECRB, groove for ECRL, groove for EPL/ED/EI (one shared label only)
cervical: all nine (Z-Anatomy labels these only on L3)
atlasaxis: atlas transverse process/foramen, vertebral foramen; axis items other than the dens (no label)
thoracic: body, pedicle, transverse process, lamina, articular processes, spinous process, vertebral foramen (labelled on L3 only)
femur: Medial and lateral lips of the linea aspera (one label for the whole line)
Articular surfaces of the tibiofemoral joint (= the condyles)
patella: all five (Patella has no labels in Z-Anatomy)

corrections: femur: Z-Anatomy medial/lateral supracondylar line labels are swapped; corrected (see MAP)
metadata.checked: every point checked 2026-11-04 by its position within its bone (medial/anterior/superior) and by rendered front/back/side views
metadata.added_2026_11_11: 25 whole-bone items (hand, foot, coccyx) and 2 spaces (vertebral and obturator foramen), by "(C) add_whole_bones_and_foramina.py"; foramen points computed from the model geometry and checked (clear of bone, outside the mesh, ringed by bone).
